findings.description: Step 3.5 relies on a hardcoded 12-item list in CreatorPhase3Controller with only an isFinTech boolean switch, lacking real French statutory rules, articles, or official citations.
findings.evidence: backend/Controllers/CreatorPhase3Controller.cs:173-214 hardcodes 6 universal items and 6 optional pool items.

findings.description: Risk of LLM hallucinating non-existent French legal codes if legal applicability is delegated to generative prompts rather than deterministic rules.
findings.evidence: SafetyRules.cs warns against legal advice, but no separation layer exists between legal rules and AI reasoning.
findings.implementation_required: Strict deterministic rule evaluation layer; AI restricted to contextual plain-language explanation.

findings.description: Current UI copy in Step 3.5 claims 'All critical regulatory and legal milestones achieved' without clear disclaimers that this is self-attested planning guidance, not formal certification.
findings.implementation_required: Enforce strict disclaimer copy: 'Planning guidance only. Not legal advice.'

findings.description: CreatorLegalChecklistItem model only contains 8 basic fields, lacking Stage, Priority, WhyItApplies, OfficialSource, and EvidenceDocumentId.
findings.implementation_required: Extend CreatorLegalChecklistItem with statutory metadata fields

findings.description: CreatorIdeaDocumentTypes only supports 'business_plan' and 'financial_forecast', rejecting all uploaded legal evidence files.
findings.evidence: backend/Models/DatabaseModels/CreatorIdea.cs:121-124 whitelist rejects any other document type.
findings.implementation_required: Extend CreatorIdeaDocumentTypes to include legal evidence constants

findings.description: The Executive Business Plan (Step 3.3) and BusinessPlanOutputDto completely lack a Legal & Regulatory Framework section.
findings.evidence: backend/Models/Dtos/Ai/BusinessPlanOutputDto.cs defines 7 sections; src/app/dashboard/creator/phase-3/business-plan/page.tsx displays 11 sections; none are Legal.
findings.implementation_required: Add Section 12: Legal & Regulatory Framework to Business Plan DTO and UI

findings.description: Level Up transition in Phase 6 transfers cap table and concept, but discards all legal checklist progress, verified documents, and evidence.
findings.evidence: backend/Controllers/CreatorPhase6Controller.cs:500-600 creates Company and Phase3Concept, but does not copy legal documents to Companies.Documents.
findings.implementation_required: Map verified legal evidence documents into Companies collection on Level Up

findings.description: Step 3.5 UI is a flat, single-column checklist of 12 cards, lacking stage-based navigation, evidence upload controls, or an AI context rail.
findings.implementation_required: Rebuild Step 3.5 into 3-pane Legal Workspace (Stages + Canvas + AI Rail)

findings.description: The Phase 3 creator dashboard lacks a dedicated smart summary card for Legal & Compliance Intelligence.
findings.evidence: Phase 3 dashboard renders generic step progress without detected business archetype pills or readiness dial.
findings.implementation_required: Create Phase3LegalCard.tsx with readiness score, France badge, and archetype tags

findings.description: Modifications to Business Model (e.g. adding B2C or online payments) do not invalidate the legal checklist, leaving founders with stale requirements.
findings.evidence: No snapshot hash or dirty flag exists on CreatorLegalChecklist.
findings.implementation_required: Compute BusinessSnapshotHash and set IsPotentiallyOutdated flag when upstream data changes

findings.description: Evidence upload and download endpoints must enforce tenant ownership checks to prevent unauthorized cross-idea file access.
findings.evidence: CreatorIdeaDocumentsController currently implements GetOwnedIdeaAsync correctly, which must be mirrored for all new legal evidence endpoints.
findings.implementation_required: Enforce GetOwnedIdeaAsync and MIME inspection on all evidence endpoints

findings.description: Investor readiness score in Step 3.7 allocates 15 points using raw CompletedCount / TotalCount * 15 without stage weighting.
findings.implementation_required: Weight critical pre-creation and pre-launch items higher in LegalReadiness calculation
